//: Separate from the root tsconfig ON PURPOSE. The root extends astro/tsconfigs/strict,
which pulls in the DOM lib; @cloudflare/workers-types redeclares Request, Response,
Headers and fetch, so loading both in one program produces duplicate-identifier
errors. Splitting the programs is what lets functions/ be typechecked at all.
Run it with `npm run check:worker` (wired into `npm run check`).
